Start
  quantrule help
  quantrule fetch sol/usd 2025-01-01 2025-02-28 --csv data/SOLUSD_M1_2025-01-01_2025-02-28.csv
  quantrule candles data/SOLUSD_M1_2025-01-01_2025-02-28.csv
  quantrule backtest --config config/examples/solusd-2025/run.json --out data/lab-result-<UTC>
  quantrule lab summary data/lab-result-<UTC> --role researcher --data-version <id> --config config/examples/solusd-2025/run.json --created-utc <UTC>

Role labs
  Quant Researcher  docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-researcher-manual.md
  Quant Developer   docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-developer-manual.md
  Quant Validator   docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-validator-manual.md

Paths are relative to the repository root.
